summary: Generates one or more POP line strips from parameter-defined points, with optional subdivision and interpolation. It can output subdivided lines or control points and can attach custom point attributes.

key_params.name: output
key_params.note: Choose subdivided lines or control points

key_params.name: interpmethod
key_params.note: Interpolation method such as linear, BSpline, cubic Bezier, or quadratic Bezier

key_params.name: multiplelinestrips
key_params.note: Allows separate line strips in one POP

key_params.name: interpmethodpersegment
key_params.note: Use separate interpolation methods per segment

key_params.name: tension
key_params.note: Cardinal line-strip tension

key_params.name: enableweights
key_params.note: Enable control-point weights for spline interpolation

key_params.name: enabletangent
key_params.note: Enable control-point tangents for spline interpolation

key_params.name: enablepointrepeat
key_params.note: Enable repeated control points for B-Splines

key_params.name: closed
key_params.note: Close generated line strips

key_params.name: pt
key_params.note: Point blocks defining positions and optional attributes

key_params.name: pt0pos
key_params.note: Position for a point block

key_params.name: divmethod
key_params.note: Controls how divisions are applied

key_params.name: divs
key_params.note: Number of divisions for the selected division method

key_params.name: dist
key_params.note: Distance between points when dividing by segment distance

key_params.name: addctrlpointattr
key_params.note: Output control-point attributes with subdivided line strips

key_params.name: resamplemethod
key_params.note: Second-stage post-resample method

key_params.name: resampledivs
key_params.note: Divisions for post-resampling

key_params.name: resampledist
key_params.note: Maximum point distance for distance-based post-resampling

key_params.name: indvarattr
key_params.note: Independent variable attribute for resampling, such as P(0)

key_params.name: indvarstep
key_params.note: Step size for independent-variable resampling

key_params.name: resamplemaxverts
key_params.note: Maximum vertices allocated for resampling

key_params.name: maxtries
key_params.note: Binary-search iteration cap for linear resampling

common_gotchas: The default is a two-point line with divisions, not a raw two-point output.
For later subdivision workflows, output control points and preserve the attributes Line Divide POP expects.
Line POP line strips are useful POP sources for trails, proximity, lookup, and GLSL displacement workflows.
